parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ model: 'llama-3.3-70b-versatile', temperature: 0, messages: [ { role: 'system', content: 'You are an eligibility checker for Indian government welfare schemes. Decide whether the applicant satisfies the scheme free-text criterion. You MUST name the exact criterion you evaluated and give concrete reasoning that references the applicant profile. Never reply with a bare yes or no. Reply ONLY with a JSON object with keys eligible (boolean), criterion (string) and reasoning (string).' }, { role: 'user', content: 'Scheme: ' + ($json.name || '') + ' | Free-text criterion: ' + ($json.other_criteria || '') + ' | Applicant profile: ' + JSON.stringify($json.profile || {}) } ], response_format: { type: 'json_object' } }) }}

parameters.jsCode: return { json: { scheme_id: $json.id, name: $json.name, source_url: $json.source_url, last_verified: $json.last_verified, benefits: $json.benefits, eligible: true, confidence: 'high', matched_criteria: ['income threshold', 'occupation match'], failed_criteria: [], explanation: 'Passed all hard rules; no free-text criteria to evaluate.' } };

nodeGroups.name: Evaluate free-text criteria
nodeGroups.description: Sends schemes with judgement-based criteria to Groq, which must name the exact criterion and its reasoning, then parses the verdict.
